service_type.description: l3 when the gateway is inside the VXLAN fabric; l2 when it stays outside.

gateway_leafs.description: Engineer-supplied fabric leaves that will host the gateway. Never inferred from discovery.

gateway_mode.description: L3 only. distributed_anycast: every participating leaf hosts the anycast gateway. centralized_anycast: a leaf pair (gateway_leafs) hosts it.

customer_type.description: internal or external customer. Picks the DC's VNI range (Lisle 20000/22000, Omaha 10000/11000); discovery proposes the next free VNI from it when vni is empty.

external_gateway_leafs.description: L2 (external gateway) only. Leaves the firewall / external gateway attaches to, when that is not the DC's border leaf pair (the default). A manual override.

svi_mtu.description: Fabric SVI MTU. Discovery copies the legacy SVI MTU, capped at the EOS maximum 9214.

secondary_prefixes.description: Secondary subnets on the legacy SVI. Not migrated; listed for review.

gateway_location.description: Filled by discovery: where the gateway lives today.

mcast_group.description: Not supported. The fabric floods BUM with head-end replication (EVPN flood lists), not multicast.

static_route_tags.description: Optional. Case-insensitive tags matched against the name on a static route. The engineer supplies these.
